questions.text: Solve for x:  (x + 5)(x - 2) = 0
Solve for x:  5x^2 + 2 = -9x  (correct to TWO decimal places)
Solve for x:  8x^2 > 2x
questions.memo_working: Standard form 8x^2 - 2x > 0; 2x(4x - 1) > 0; critical values x = 0 and x = 1/4; sign analysis -> x < 0 or x > 1/4

questions.memo_note: Alternative memo method substitutes k = 2^x: 2k^2 - 9k + 4 = 0; (2k - 1)(k - 4) = 0; k = 1/2 or k = 4.

questions.text: Solve for x:  sqrt( sqrt(1/x) + 2 ) = 1/sqrt(x)
questions.memo_working: Square both sides: sqrt(1/x) + 2 = 1/x; isolate surd: sqrt(1/x) = 1/x - 2; square again: 1/x = 1/x^2 - 4/x + 4; 1/x^2 - 5/x + 4 = 0; 4x^2 - 5x + 1 = 0; (4x - 1)(x - 1) = 0; x = 1/4, and x = 1 is rejected on checking
questions.memo_note: Alternative memo method substitutes k = sqrt(1/x): sqrt(k + 2) = k; k^2 - k - 2 = 0; (k - 2)(k + 1) = 0; k = 2 (k = -1 rejected); sqrt(1/x) = 2 -> x = 1/4.

questions.text: Calculate the values of x and y if: x is the sum of 2 and y; Five times the product of x and y, is 6 more than the square of x
questions.memo_note: Alternative memo method substitutes y = x - 2 into 5xy - 6 = x^2: 2x^2 - 5x - 3 = 0; (2x + 1)(x - 3) = 0.

The depth of a torpedo below sea level forms a quadratic pattern, where 0 metres is at sea level. A submarine tracked a torpedo in one-second intervals. [Figure: drawing of a submarine with a torpedo below it.] The depth (in metres) that the torpedo reached is given in the table below. At the end of the first second: 36; At the end of the first 2 seconds: 71; At the end of the first 3 seconds: 104. Calculate the depth of the torpedo at the end of the first 5 seconds.
questions.memo_working: 36 ; 71 ; 104 ; 135 ; 164 with first differences 35 ; 33 ; 31 ; 29 and second difference -2; T5 = 164

questions.text: Show that the depth of the torpedo at the end of n seconds was Tn = -n^2 + 38n - 1
Calculate the maximum depth that the torpedo reached.
After how many seconds was the torpedo at 104 m below sea level for the second time?
questions.memo_working: By symmetry about n = 19: (n + 3)/2 = 19; n + 3 = 38; n = 35
questions.memo_note: Alternative memo method solves -n^2 + 38n - 1 = 104: n^2 - 38n + 105 = 0; (n - 35)(n - 3) = 0; n = 35.

questions.text: The graph of f(x) = log_(1/3) x is drawn below. Point A is the x-intercept of f and (3 ; t) lies on f. [Figure: decreasing logarithmic curve f in the first/fourth quadrants, cutting the x-axis at A and passing through the labelled point (3 ; t) below the x-axis.] Calculate the value of t
Write down the coordinates of A.
Determine the equation of f^(-1), the inverse of f, in the form y = ...
questions.memo_working: y = log_(1/3) x; swop x and y: x = log_(1/3) y; y = (1/3)^x = 3^(-x)

questions.text: The graph of h is obtained when f^(-1) is translated 5 units to the right. Determine the y-values of h where x > 4.
questions.memo_working: (4 ; 3) is a point on h (h(x) = (1/3)^(x-5), h(4) = 3); for x > 4 the decreasing curve gives 0 < y < 3

questions.text: The graphs of f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c and g(x) = -4/(x - 3) + 8 are drawn below. P is the turning point of f and the point of intersection of the asymptotes of g. The graphs intersect at D(5 ; 6). M and T are x-intercepts of f and g respectively. [Figure: concave-down parabola f with x-intercept M left of the origin and turning point P on the dotted vertical asymptote x = 3; hyperbola g with branches above-left and below-right of the asymptote intersection, dotted horizontal asymptote through P, g cutting the x-axis at T; f and g intersect at D(5 ; 6).] Write down the domain of g.
questions.memo_working: Vertical asymptote at x = 3, so x ∈ R, x ≠ 3

questions.text: Write down the range of f.
questions.memo_working: Turning point P(3 ; 8) is a maximum, so y ≤ 8

questions.text: Determine the values of x for which g(x) ≤ f(x)
questions.memo_working: Between the vertical asymptote x = 3 and the intersection point D(5 ; 6)

questions.text: Determine the values of x for which f(x) < 6
questions.memo_working: f(x) = 6 at x = 1 and x = 5 (symmetric about x = 3); f below 6 outside these values

The graphs of g(x) = x + c and f(x) = a/(x + p) + q are drawn below. Graph g and the vertical asymptote of f intersect at the x-axis. [Figure: increasing line g through the origin area cutting the x-axis right of O where the dotted vertical asymptote of f meets it; hyperbola f with one branch above the horizontal asymptote (dotted, below the x-axis) to the right of the vertical asymptote and the other branch below it to the left.] Write down the coordinates of the x-intercept of g in terms of p.
questions.memo_working: The vertical asymptote of f is x = -p, and g cuts the x-axis there

questions.text: Graph g intersects the horizontal asymptote of graph f at x = 1 and the graph f at x = 3. Graphs f and g also intersect on the y-axis. Determine the equation of f.
questions.memo_working: x-intercept of g is x = -c, which is also the vertical asymptote of f, so p = c; g meets the horizontal asymptote at x = 1, so q = g(1) = 1 + c; f(x) = a/(x + c) + 1 + c. Intersection on y-axis (0 ; c): c = a/c + 1 + c -> a = -c; point (3 ; 3 + c) on f: 3 + c = -c/(3 + c) + 1 + c; 9 + 6c + c^2 = -c + 3 + 4c + c^2; 3c = -6; c = -2; a = 2; q = -1; f(x) = 2/(x - 2) - 1
questions.memo_note: Alternative memo method finds a = 6 + 2c from the point (3 ; 3 + c) first, then uses the y-axis intersection (0 ; c) to get c = -2, a = 2, q = -1.

questions.text: Describe the transformation that g must undergo to become an axis of symmetry of f that cuts f at two points.
questions.memo_answer: Translation of 1 unit down OR translation of 1 unit to the right
questions.memo_working: The increasing axis of symmetry of f is y = x - 3 (through (2 ; -1)); g: y = x - 2 must shift 1 unit down or 1 unit right

questions.text: A travel company informs Robert that a holiday to a certain destination costs R40 000 now. The company predicts that the cost of this holiday will increase by 7,8% per annum. What will this holiday cost in 5 years' time?

Sarah opened a savings account that paid interest at a rate of 5,8% p.a., compounded quarterly. She deposited R2 300 into the account on 1 January 2020 and continued to make deposits of R2 300 at the beginning of each quarter thereafter. She made her last deposit on 1 October 2025. Calculate the accumulated amount in the account on 1 January 2026.

The bank granted Rajesh a loan of R900 000 on 28 February 2024 at an interest rate of 6,8% p.a., compounded monthly. Rajesh was unable to make the first three payments. He made his first repayment of R10 000 on 30 June 2024. He continued to make monthly repayments of R10 000 at the end of each month thereafter. How long, in completed months, will it take Rajesh to repay the loan from the time the loan was granted?
questions.memo_answer: 133 months since the loan was granted

A rectangular metal sheet has dimensions x and h units, with x > h, and a perimeter of 50 units. The metal sheet is rolled into a cylinder with two open ends (top and bottom) and height h units. [Figure: rectangle with width x and height h alongside an open cylinder of height h formed by rolling the sheet.] Show that the volume of the cylinder is given by V = 25x^2/(4π) - x^3/(4π)
Calculate the value of x that will maximise the volume of the cylinder.

A survey was conducted among female and male learners at a school about which type of cold drink they preferred. The data from the survey is presented in the table below. [Table: rows Female (JUICE a, ENERGY DRINKS b, TOTAL c), Male (JUICE 36, ENERGY DRINKS 54, TOTAL f), Total (JUICE e, ENERGY DRINKS d, TOTAL 210).] The events male and preferring juice are independent. Show that e = 84.
questions.memo_working: P(Male and Prefer juice) = P(Male) × P(Prefer juice); 36/210 = (90/210)(e/210); e = 84

questions.text: At a kiosk, 120 people buy either a cup of coffee or a bottle of water. The chance of rain on any given day is 75%. The chance of a person buying a cup of coffee on a rainy day is three times the chance of the person buying coffee on a non-rainy day. The probability of a person buying coffee on any given day is 7/12. Calculate the number of cups of coffee that will be sold on a non-rainy day.
questions.memo_note: Alternative memo methods work with counts: (75/100)(3x/120) + (25/100)(x/120) = 7/12 -> x = 28 cups; or with 120 - x bottles of water giving x = 92 water, so 28 cups of coffee.

questions.text: Eight runners compete in a race where there are no tied finishes. Bongi and Andrew are two of the competitors. Calculate the total number of possible ways in which the 8 runners can finish the race if Bongi finishes in a position immediately after Andrew.
Calculate the probability that TWO OR MORE runners finish the race after Andrew and before Bongi.
questions.memo_working: Favourable outcomes: Andrew and Bongi separated by 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6 runners: 5×6! + 4×6! + 3×6! + 2×6! + 1×6! = 6!(15); P = 6!(15)/8! = 15/56 = 0,27
